expert_cache.full_model_default_preload: all 512 exact experts for each of 48 layers are packed at model load; 24,576 entries and 68,080,435,200 bytes
expert_cache.packed_host_zero_storage: one shared exact-zero BFP4 rank shard per layer; cached experts retain only their exact owner shard
expert_cache.parallelism: EP2 deterministic owner expert_id % 2; shared expert remains TP2
expert_cache.replacement: stable indexed generation-checked LRU slots for traced decode; deterministic generation-checked LRU waves for prefill
expert_cache.trace_index_contract: a persistent replicated uint16 slot-index row changes router order without relocating hit expert weights; owner H2D, non-owner zero D2D, index publication, and the consuming back trace remain ordered on CQ0 with completion observed at the next compact route/token boundary
expert_cache.failure_semantics: publish a generation only after the owner upload and exact non-owner D2D zero reset are successfully enqueued; invalidate on a submission failure, and surface asynchronous device failures at the next mandatory route/token completion boundary

refuted_exact_candidates: owner-threaded depth 10 with a prestarted reused executor
host_staging_policy.next_boundary: native batched TTNN H2D submission with one call/event per physical owner; first require a pure-dual result materially above 6.497517 GB/s

ple_table.lookup_contract: torch.unique deduplicates each exact batched request, then per-shard index_select gathers only misses from safetensors mmap handles
ple_table.chunk_contract: 128 logical rows per device prefill staging wave; public non-aligned tails are padded, masked, and sliced internally
ple_table.pinned_host_staging: unavailable in torch 2.11.0+cpu on this host; contiguous CPU rows are handed to TT runtime staging
ple_table.trace_completion_contract: decode H2D enqueue is nonblocking; CQ0 ordering makes the following exact route-id read the completion boundary; close performs the only final mesh synchronization

blocking_limitation: No exact Python-level cache scheduling candidate improved selected serial depth 1. Reaching the raw two-link opportunity requires a native batched TTNN H2D submission/event boundary that the current Python cache API does not expose.
measured_limitations: Deterministically prepacking 24,576 exact host experts adds 240.979 seconds and 68,080,435,200 bytes to model load, but removes source packing from request TTFT and decode.
Host-backed segmented token-out tracing is batch one; the all-48 host-backed eager fixed-slot path is validated at batch 32 and context 4096.
The datatype-sweep selected 128+128 warmed token-out path is 231.594000 ms/token (4.317901 tokens/s/user). Traced teacher forcing, not token-out, is the dtype Pareto and selection metric.
